city_editions_hours_check.name: city_editions_hours_check

city_editions_period_check.name: city_editions_period_check

coupons_value_schedule_check.name: coupons_value_schedule_check

coupons_valid_minutes_check.name: coupons_valid_minutes_check
coupons_valid_minutes_check.value: ("coupons"."valid_from_minute" IS NULL AND "coupons"."valid_to_minute" IS NULL) OR ("coupons"."valid_from_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439 AND "coupons"."valid_to_minute" BETWEEN 1 AND 1440 AND "coupons"."valid_from_minute" < "coupons"."valid_to_minute")
